procedure: State: The same failing configuration, dependency constraints and repeatable task test support repeated reductions. Procedure: Partition elements, test valid removals and complements, retain failure-preserving reductions, refine partitions when blocked and finish with all valid one-element deletions. Independently recheck the retained failure and selected interaction boundaries within the 80-test budget. Limits and stopping conditions: Dependencies, unresolved outcomes, multiple minima and exhausted budget restrict conclusions.
action: Partition elements, test valid removals and complements, retain failure-preserving reductions, refine partitions when blocked and finish with all valid one-element deletions. Independently recheck the retained failure and selected interaction boundaries within the 80-test budget.
observables: Failing subsets, passing deletions, unresolved trials and repeated interaction-boundary outcomes.
inferential_warrant: A reproducible retained subset is sufficient for this failure; only a completed deletion check supports one-deletion minimality. Complement and interaction tests distinguish alternative local explanations without global minimum or unique-root-cause claims.
problem_decomposition: Represent configurations, deletion boundaries and interactions rather than a single feature ranking.
next_inquiry: Choose the next partition/complement from remaining reduction uncertainty, prioritize unresolved interaction checks and report the exact achieved minimality at budget stop.
